search_window.basis: Prior hourly scheduled check as lower-bound proxy; latest completed checkpoint not independently retrieved.

coverage_notes.role: Supplementary bounded high-value missed-signal recall watch; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
classes_checked: Only, sole, last, or full-service grocery loss or closure affecting food access
Canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to weather/disaster/outage/damage
Abrupt food pantry or food-bank closure or major service reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.window_result: No newly published, nonduplicate qualifying U.S. food-access disruptions verified within the bounded hourly observation window.
coverage_notes.exclusions: Older grocery-store closures, Alabama October 9 storm cancellation, prior unconfirmed Helping Hands candidate, routine storm relief distribution announcements, historical 2025 SNAP shutdown articles, holiday office closures, guides, fundraising and generic program information excluded.
coverage_notes.source_limitations: Fresh search indexes may lag direct notices. Prior-check exact completion time could not be verified; start time conservatively anchored to prior hourly schedule.
coverage_notes.disposition: No review item emitted. No approval, publication, or schedule modification.
